title: The early modern world, 1500–1800
reviewed: 2026-10-18. Each quote was copied from the linked article and is checked by npm run verify:sources.

events.title: Luther's Ninety-five Theses
events.summary: Martin Luther challenges the sale of indulgences. The Protestant Reformation grows from the dispute.

source.quote: written in 1517 by Martin Luther

events.title: The first voyage around the world
events.summary: A Spanish fleet sails west under Magellan. After his death, Elcano brings one ship home around the world.

source.quote: departed Spain in 1519 and returned there in 1522

events.title: Copernicus publishes a Sun-centered model
events.summary: Nicolaus Copernicus places the Sun, not the Earth, at the center of the universe.

source.quote: just before his death in 1543

events.title: The Spanish Armada sails against England
events.summary: A great Spanish fleet sails to invade England and fails.

source.quote: sailed from Lisbon in late May 1588

events.title: The King James Bible is published
events.summary: The Church of England publishes a new English translation of the Bible. It is read widely for centuries.

source.quote: the 1611 text reflects Early Modern English usage

events.title: The Thirty Years' War
events.summary: Religious and political conflict tears through Central Europe. It is one of Europe's most destructive wars.

source.quote: fought primarily in Central Europe between 1618 and 1648

events.title: Galileo's Dialogue
events.summary: Galileo defends a Sun-centered universe in print. The Inquisition later puts him on trial.

source.quote: (Dialogue Concerning the Two Chief World Systems, 1632)

events.title: The Peace of Westphalia
events.summary: Two treaties end the Thirty Years' War. They shape the European system of states.

source.quote: two peace treaties signed in October 1648

events.title: The Battle of Vienna
events.summary: A relief army breaks the Ottoman siege of Vienna. Ottoman expansion into Europe begins to reverse.

source.quote: on 12 September 1683

events.title: Newton's Principia
events.summary: Isaac Newton sets out his laws of motion and universal gravitation.

source.quote: and first published in 1687

events.title: Peter the Great founds Saint Petersburg
events.summary: The tsar builds a new city on the Baltic. It becomes the capital of the Russian Empire.

source.quote: founded by Tsar Peter the Great on 27 May 1703

events.title: The storming of the Bastille
events.summary: Crowds in Paris seize a royal fortress. It becomes the symbol of the French Revolution.

source.quote: on 14 July 1789

events.image: File:Shah Ismail I portrait, Chehel Sotoun, painted circa 1647.jpg
events.title: The Safavid dynasty rules Iran
events.summary: The Safavids found a new Iranian empire and make Shia Islam its state religion.

source.quote: ruled by the Safavid dynasty from 1501 to 1736

events.title: Suleiman the Magnificent
events.summary: The Ottoman Empire reaches its height under Suleiman. His armies besiege Vienna in 1529.

source.quote: the Ottoman sultan from 1520 to 1566

events.title: The Atlantic slave trade
events.summary: European traders ship about 12.75 million Africans to the Americas as slaves. Up to 2 million die on the voyage.

quote: trade to the Americas began in the 16th century, lasting well into the 19th century
about 12.75 million Africans were loaded onto slave ships

events.title: Morocco defeats Songhai at Tondibi
events.summary: A Moroccan army with firearms defeats the Songhai Empire near Gao.

source.quote: On 13 March 1591, the armies met

events.title: Queen Nzinga rules Ndongo
events.summary: Nzinga leads the Ambundu kingdoms of Ndongo and Matamba against Portuguese conquest.

source.quote: In 1624, she assumed power over Ndongo

events.title: Gondar becomes Ethiopia's capital
events.summary: Emperor Fasilides settles his court at Gondar and builds a stone castle.

source.quote: In 1636, Emperor Fasilides selected Gondar

events.image: File:Aernout Smit Table Bay, 1683 William Fehr Collection Cape Town.jpg
events.title: The Dutch found a station at the Cape
events.summary: The Dutch East India Company builds a supply post at the Cape of Good Hope. A colony grows from it.

source.quote: founded in 1652 by a VOC expedition under Jan van Riebeeck

events.title: The Asante Empire rises
events.summary: Osei Tutu unites the Asante under the Golden Stool. The empire lasts two centuries.

source.quote: lasted from 1701 to 1902

events.title: Babur founds the Mughal Empire
events.summary: Babur defeats the Sultan of Delhi at Panipat. His Mughal dynasty comes to rule most of India.

source.quote: on 21 April 1526

events.title: The Taj Mahal is built
events.summary: Shah Jahan builds a white marble tomb for his wife Mumtaz Mahal.

events.title: The Battle of Plassey
events.summary: The British East India Company defeats the Nawab of Bengal. British rule in India begins to grow.

source.quote: on 23 June 1757

events.title: The Portuguese settle Macau
events.summary: Portuguese traders found a settlement on the south China coast. It stays Portuguese until 1999.

source.quote: the first official Portuguese settlement in 1557

events.title: Japan invades Korea
events.summary: Japanese armies invade Korea twice. Korea and Ming China drive them out.

events.title: The Battle of Sekigahara
events.summary: Tokugawa Ieyasu wins control of Japan in a great battle.

source.quote: occurred on October 21, 1600

events.title: The Tokugawa shogunate begins
events.summary: The Tokugawa shoguns rule Japan from Edo for more than two and a half centuries.

source.quote: during the Edo period from 1603 to 1868

events.title: The Qing take Beijing
events.summary: The Manchu Qing dynasty takes the Ming capital. It rules China until 1912.

source.quote: seized control of the Ming capital Beijing and North China in 1644

events.title: Portugal captures Malacca
events.summary: Afonso de Albuquerque takes the great trading port on the Strait of Malacca.

source.quote: conquered the city of Malacca in 1511

events.title: Spain founds Manila
events.summary: Miguel López de Legazpi makes Manila the capital of the Spanish Philippines. Its galleons link Asia and the Americas.

source.quote: On June 24, 1571

events.title: The Dutch found Batavia
events.summary: The Dutch East India Company builds its Asian headquarters on Java.

source.quote: The founding of Batavia by the Dutch in 1619

events.title: The Oirats unite in Dzungaria
events.summary: Western Mongol peoples unite in Dzungaria. They later build the Dzungar Khanate.

source.quote: In about 1620, the western Mongols, known as the Oirats, united

events.title: The fall of Tenochtitlan
events.summary: Hernán Cortés and his Indigenous allies take the Aztec capital. Spanish rule of Mexico begins.

source.quote: It occurred in 1521

events.title: Pizarro captures Atahualpa
events.summary: Spanish soldiers seize the last Sapa Inca at Cajamarca. The conquest of the Inca Empire begins.

source.wiki: Spanish conquest of the Inca Empire
source.quote: at the Battle of Cajamarca in 1532

events.title: The silver city of Potosí
events.summary: Silver from a mountain in the Andes makes Potosí rich. It becomes a major city of the Spanish Empire.

source.quote: Founded in 1545 as a mining town

events.title: English colonists found Jamestown
events.summary: The Virginia Company founds the first lasting English settlement in North America.

source.quote: on May 4, 1607 O.S.

events.title: The Pilgrims found Plymouth Colony
events.summary: English separatists from the Mayflower found the first permanent colony in New England.

source.quote: the first permanent English colony in New England, founded in 1620

events.title: The Declaration of Independence
events.summary: Thirteen American colonies declare independence from Great Britain.

source.quote: On July 4, 1776, it was adopted unanimously

events.title: The United States Constitution is written
events.summary: Delegates in Philadelphia draft a new framework of government for the United States.

source.quote: between May 25 and September 17, 1787

events.title: The Haitian Revolution
events.summary: Enslaved people in Saint-Domingue rise against French rule. They found the free nation of Haiti.

events.title: Abel Tasman reaches New Zealand
events.summary: A Dutch voyage reaches Tasmania and New Zealand. It is the first known European visit to either.

source.quote: best known for his voyages of 1642 and 1644

events.title: James Cook's first Pacific voyage
events.summary: Cook observes the transit of Venus at Tahiti. He then charts New Zealand and the east coast of Australia.

source.quote: aboard HMS Endeavour, from 1768 to 1771

events.title: The First Fleet reaches Sydney Cove
events.summary: British ships carrying convicts found a penal colony at Port Jackson. Colonization of Australia begins.

source.quote: the Fleet arrived there on 26 January 1788
